"''I am, sir.|Poe Dameron and Goode during their escape|}} '''Pammich Nerro Goode''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a lead dispatcher for the [[Resistance]] at their [[Resistance base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. ==Biography== At some point, Pammich Nerro Goode [[pilot]]ed a [[Resistance transport]] from the [[Resistance]]'s [[Resistance base|base]] on [[D'Qar]].{{FFGXW2|set=Resistance Transport Expansion Pack|cardname=Pammich Nerro Goode}} [[File:PammichNerroGoode-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Goode piloted a Resistance transport from the surface of D'Qar.]] Holding the rank of [[ensign]] during the Resistance's [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]], Goode was present in the D'Qar base control room for the preparations and execution of the Resistance's [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]].{{Film|VII}} She sided with [[Captain]] [[Poe Dameron]] when he mutinied against [[Amilyn Holdo|Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo]]. Shortly after this, she was present to [[pilot]] a [[U-55 orbital loadlifter]] with co-pilot [[Cova Nell]],''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' to transport Dameron and [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] down to the abandoned base on the planet [[Crait]]. Goode participated in the [[Battle of Crait]], flying a [[V-4X-D ski speeder]]. She died during the battle along with several [[Resistance pilot]]s. ==Personality and traits== Pammich Nerro Goode was [[human]] [[Gender|female]] with dark skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]] and brown eyes. ==Equipment== [[File:Pammich-Goode-helmet-TLJVD.png|thumb|right|150px|Goode's flight helmet]] While in the D'Qar base, Pammich Nerro Goode wore a [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|lead dispatcher's uniform]]. For flying, Goode wore a [[Color|yellow]] [[flight suit]] with a white vest, [[harness]], [[life support]] system and gray [[glove]]s. She wore a white and red [[flight helmet]] borrowed from another starfighter pilot, that bore the name "STEVE" inscribed in [[Aurebesh]]. She carried a [[Glie-44 blaster pistol]], which was holstered on her [[utility belt]].''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' ==Behind the scenes== Pammich Nerro Goode first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], portrayed by [[Crystal Clarke]]. She was first identified as "[[Ensign]] Goode" in the film's credits, and was named "Pamich Nerro" in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film. Her full name, "Pamich Nerro Goode," was shown in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''. Despite the game being non-[[canon]], story group member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters, including Goode, were considered canon.{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}} In ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', the character's first name is spelled "Pammich." This new spelling has since been adopted by subsequent media releases, including [[Topps]]' [[Star Wars: Card Trader]], [[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]], and [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *{{Film|VIII}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' {{1stID|Pamich Nerro Goode}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Pamich Nerro}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|50|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{ID|Pamich}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Pammich Nerro Goode}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{FFGXW2|set=Resistance Transport Expansion Pack|cardname=Pammich Nerro Goode}} *{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Women of Star Wars|cardname=#59: Pamich Nerro Goode|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/216003/cid/14374552/2020-Topps-Women-of-Star-Wars-59-Pamich-Nerro-Goode|nobackup=1}} *''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' *{{GoS|Beeps}} *{{Databank|pammich-nerro-goode|Pammich Nerro Goode}} *{{Databank|resistance-pilots|Resistance Pilots}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Pamich Nerro Goode#kanon |fr=Pammich Nerro Goode |ja=パミッチ・ネロ・グッド |ko=파미치 네로 구드 |nl=Pamich Nerro Goode |pl=Pamich Nerro Goode }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Goode, Pamich Nerro}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Pilots]] [[Category:Resistance members]]
